headline: Sensex rises 400 points, Nifty tops 22,650; sugar and power stocks lead gains amid positive global cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Positive global cues and gains in Asian markets boosted investor sentiment
India's services PMI rose to 55.2 in September, signaling demand recovery
Softening oil prices and a positive start for GIFT Nifty provided support
Investors are positioning themselves ahead of the upcoming RBI interest rate decision
whatHappening: Sensex jumped over 400 points while Nifty 50 traded above the 22,650 level
Sugar sector stocks rallied up to 9% in early trade following market gains
Adani Power partnered with Druk Green for a 770 MW hydropower project in Bhutan
Newly-listed Steamhouse India hit a 10% upper circuit after reporting an 80% rise in net profit
summary: The Indian stock market showed strong momentum on Tuesday, with the Sensex and Nifty hitting key levels amid positive global cues. Gains were led by sugar, power, and heavyweight stocks like Reliance, supported by strong services PMI data. Investors remain focused on the upcoming RBI rate decision while monitoring geopolitical developments in West Asia.
